chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Dahqan, from Durust, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
Eating the apple and the coriander causes forgetfulness.
ai.seo_question: What is the effect of eating apples and coriander according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Imam al-Ridha (AS), the consumption of apples and coriander is linked to forgetfulness, reflecting the Shia tradition of integrating dietary habits with cognitive health. This teaching aligns with the broader Islamic emphasis on maintaining mental clarity for worship and recitation, as seen in the Prophet's practice of using coriander for health. The narration serves as a practical guideline for believers seeking to preserve their memory and focus in daily religious and worldly affairs.
